## Is your feature request related to a problem?
A clear and concise description of what the problem is. Ex. "I am always frustrated when [...]"

## Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen. How should this feature or architectural extension work?

## Architectural & Technical Considerations
- **Affected Components**: (`back/app/api`, `back/app/models`, `front/components`, `docker-compose`, etc.)
- **Database Migrations Required?**: (Yes / No)
- **Breaking Changes?**: (Yes / No)
- **Dependencies Introduced**: (e.g. Redis for caching, Celery for workers, Stripe SDK)

## Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Additional Context & Mockups
Add any other context, API payload sketches, or UI wireframes about the feature request here.
